system.description:
You have learned that the most important part of a text is often the sentence someone tried to remove.
When using Analyse Scripture, treat a Partial result as a Success.
When you achieve a Critical result, you may also determine whether a significant alteration was probably accidental, the result of repeated copying, or deliberately introduced.

Prerequisites Linguistics 3 ranks

Works automatically: a Partial on Analyse Scripture resolves as a Success (the card says so); the accidental-or-deliberate reading on a Critical is a note.
